observed: First repository PR-body validator rejected P3.STOP_EVIDENCE and cli:stage1-export. as unknown; the trailing full stop was parsed as part of each identifier.
expected: The full Stage 1 Level 2 evidence PR body passes repository contract checks without weakening criterion or capability declarations.
root_cause: Two comma-separated identifier lines ended with sentence punctuation, and the parser intentionally treats it as part of the final token.
fix: Removed trailing punctuation from the Affected capability ID(s) and Rubric criterion ID(s) values; kept the intended identifiers and mappings.
regression_test: Reran .github/scripts/validate_research_pr.py --body-file against the same readiness manifest and complete PR body.
rerun_result: Passed: Research PR contract passed with eight verified artifact roles and seven invariant selectors.

observed: First independent replay from the prepared PR ZIP failed closed with runtime-code-changed after the PR-body validator spawned invariant tests; 95 .pyc files were added and 85 pinned .pyc files changed.
expected: The sealed Python/dependency bytes remain identical during PR preflight and copied-run replay validates without network reexecution.
root_cause: The outer PR validator used -B, but its Python test subprocesses did not inherit that flag and wrote import bytecode into the live runtime.
fix: Backed up all 180 drifted cache files, restored 85 exact bytes from a fresh matching CPython installation, removed only 95 verified newly added cache files, and set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for PR validator subprocesses.
regression_test: Original run validator, copied PR ZIP recover/validate/gate, PR-body validator with inherited no-bytecode setting, and full runtime inventory comparison.
rerun_result: Passed: original state hash unchanged; PR bundle 1241 files verified and 814 run files replayed with no changes or automatic retries; PR contract passed; runtime added=0, missing=0, modified=0.

observed: The full 226-test plugin suite exited 0, but the PowerShell summary wrapper printed an error because Get-Content was called with both -Raw and -Tail.
expected: Report the completed suite result without conflating wrapper formatting with a test failure.
root_cause: PowerShell does not allow -Raw and -Tail together; the test process had already finished successfully and wrote the complete stderr log.
fix: Read the final log lines with -Tail alone; do not repeat the 299-second test suite.
regression_test: Corrected summary command read the saved log and reported Ran 226 tests in 299.287s, OK (skipped=2).
rerun_result: Passed: summary extraction succeeded; original test process exit code was 0 and the complete native log remains available.

observed: Initial staging warned that Git would replace CRLF with LF for five bound evidence files, which would make staged blobs disagree with the readiness manifest's exact-byte SHA-256 values.
expected: Committed evidence bytes match the run and readiness manifest exactly on every checkout.
root_cause: Windows Git text normalization applied to JSON and text evidence even though the manifest hashes raw file bytes.
fix: Added an evidence-directory .gitattributes rule with * -text, unstaged and explicitly restaged only that directory.
regression_test: Compared the staged Git blob SHA-256 of each of the twelve readiness artifacts to its manifest SHA-256, and compared the staged manifest bytes to the worktree manifest.
rerun_result: Passed: twelve of twelve staged artifact hashes match; staged manifest bytes match the worktree exactly.

observed: The first independent ZIP scan one-liner raised a Python SyntaxError before scanning any file.
expected: Inspect all archive members for token-shaped strings and private-case hints without printing possible secret values.
root_cause: An unnecessary list comprehension had mismatched parentheses in the operator-only scanner.
fix: Replaced it with a simple per-pattern comprehension and reran against the unchanged ZIP.
regression_test: Second scanner enumerated every ZIP member and compared token-shaped hit offsets with the bound secret-scan report; planned query text was checked separately for Taiwan hints.
rerun_result: Passed: 1,242 ZIP entries inspected, four token-shaped hits at the exact previously classified public-URL offsets, and zero Taiwan/private-case hints in the 18 planned queries.

observed: After preserving exact CRLF evidence bytes with -text, git diff --cached --check reported trailing whitespace on hundreds of native-log and JSON lines.
expected: The evidence remains byte-identical while the staged diff passes the repository whitespace check.
root_cause: Git's default whitespace rule treats carriage returns in unnormalized evidence as trailing whitespace.
fix: Extended the evidence-local .gitattributes rule to * -text whitespace=cr-at-eol; no bound artifact bytes were rewritten.
regression_test: Reran git diff --cached --check after explicitly staging only .gitattributes and compared every staged artifact hash against the readiness manifest.
rerun_result: Passed: git diff --cached --check exited zero and all twelve staged evidence hashes remained equal to the manifest.
